annotation.title_clean: Proceso de revisión de la Estrategia de IA y de elaboración de la Estrategia Nacional de Datos para Uruguay
annotation.title_en: Process for reviewing the AI Strategy and developing the National Data Strategy for Uruguay
annotation.authors_or_issuer: AGESIC (Agencia para el Desarrollo del Gobierno de Gestión Electrónica y la Sociedad de la Información y del Conocimiento)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: AGESIC presentation describing the participatory five-stage process to review Uruguay's 2020 AI Strategy for Digital Government and create a National Data Strategy, with CAF and UNESCO cooperation, using UNESCO's Readiness Assessment Methodology, dialogue tables, public consultation and launch of an AI observatory.
key_provisions_or_claims: Five-stage process: diagnosis, proposals, drafting, public consultation, validation and publication
Uses UNESCO RAM and CAF tools for diagnosis
Participatory dialogue tables with state, academia, private sector and civil society
Public consultation on draft AI and data strategies
Launch of an AI observatory with state AI use cases and technical guides
